sources: Library history (7191997, d8e475a, d403e92, ad71726): derived from the pinned references in references.json and the pilot sample only.
Every upstream PR or issue named in tracker files, commit messages and issues #1224, #1227, #1300 and #1303.
The review-corpus release: absent (tag not found) and added after the library's last change, so not a derivation source.
Model training exposure cannot be inventoried; the protocol already treats it as unmeasured.

blockers: The environment's inference endpoint rejected every direct request with HTTP 429 over several minutes of backoff; the controller's own already-informed session is not a permitted fallback.
Fresh reviewer/scorer isolation has not been verified.
Historical packets (including title, description and guidance as of first feedback) are not reconstructed yet.
deviations: Eleven PRs authored by cgwalters were rejected as having no reviewer feedback from him (#1300 asks for PRs he reviewed). The frozen protocol does not state this rule and it was applied after the discovery titles were seen; a human must accept it or require a new sample under a revised protocol.
Eligibility used current titles from search; historical titles and descriptions are reconstructed only with the packets.
open_concerns: Creation-ascending discovery selects 2019-2023 PRs, where model training exposure is most likely.
B167's only cgwalters record is a review submitted four seconds before merge and may yield no scorable root; the protocol keeps it in the denominator.
human_adjudication: Not obtained; preserve the pilot's outstanding human-adjudication request.
